entities.summary: Michael Thomas Conforto, nicknamed "Scooter", is an American professional baseball outfielder for the Chicago Cubs of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the New York Mets, San Francisco Giants, and Los Angeles Dodgers.
